title: VHPA — Helicopter Pilots Who Died in the Vietnam War (KIA index)
citation: Vietnam Helicopter Pilots Association, "Helicopter Pilots Who Died in the Vietnam War," online index with one page per man giving date, unit, aircraft, location and circumstances. https://www.vhpa.org/KIA/KIAINDEX.HTM
notes: A veteran-maintained roll of the helicopter pilots and crew members who died in the war, built from the DoD casualty file and unit records, with one page per man giving date, unit, aircraft, location and circumstances. Checked on 2026-09-05 for a pilot Larry remembers by name: no one on the roll matches what he describes.
